top_signals.title: 58 arrested in international cybercrime crackdown
top_signals.summary: Interpol officials said it uncovered a crime-as-a-service network in Argentina run by 196 people that provided website domains and money laundering support to West African organized crime groups like Black Axe.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
